name: DPM-Solver-Fast
plain: The DPM-Solver fixed-budget driver. It takes the requested step count as a model-call budget, spreads order-3 stages uniformly in log σ, and ignores the schedule apart from its end points. It stops at the last non-zero sigma instead of jumping to zero.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
t=−log σ; h=t'−t. N=len(sigmas)−1 is the NFE budget; m=⌊N/3⌋+1 uniform t-intervals; orders [3]*(m−2)+[2,1] if 3|N else [3]*(m−1)+[N%3].
ε=(x−D)/σ. Order 1: x'=x−σ'(e^h−1)ε.
Order 2 (r₁=½): u=x−σ(s₁)(e^{r₁h}−1)ε; x'=x−σ'(e^h−1)ε−(σ'/(2r₁))(e^h−1)(ε₁−ε).
Order 3 (r₁=⅓,r₂=⅔): u₁ as above; u₂=x−σ(s₂)(e^{r₂h}−1)ε−σ(s₂)(r₂/r₁)((e^{r₂h}−1)/(r₂h)−1)(ε₁−ε); x'=x−σ'(e^h−1)ε−(σ'/r₂)((e^h−1)/h−1)(ε₂−ε).

props.stages: 1,2 or 3 per interval; total exactly N
props.final_sigma0: Wrapper replaces a 0 end with sigmas[-2]; loop ends there, no denoise-to-zero, residual noise at that σ remains.
props.flow_const: No CONST branch; uses −log σ on all models. First-order term is the same Euler line.

label: from code
surprise: Only sigmas[0], the last non-zero σ and len(sigmas) are used. Sigmas [σ,0] make t_start equal t_end, so one model call leaves x unchanged (read, not run). Wrapper accepts no extra options, so eta cannot reach it.
